how_to_use: Line 1 is this header. Every later line is one finding: json.loads it. a and b are [fileIndex, firstLine, lastLine] into files[]. Read those ranges from disk yourself - code bodies are intentionally not included here. Findings are sorted longest first; start at the top.

record.k: 0=two places in ONE file, 1=two DIFFERENT files
record.sim: 0.80-1.00 share of lines identical; LOWER BOUND, see caveats
record.h: first code line, for recognition only

caveats: Comparison is on NORMALISED lines: identifiers -> V, numbers -> 0, literals -> empty, whitespace dropped. Two blocks differing only in names/values score 1.0 - that is intended.
Sides advance in lockstep, so only substitutions are modelled, not insertions. A block with an extra line on one side scores lower than it deserves. sim never overstates.
A pair sharing no seed_lines identical lines in a row is not found at all.
sim 1.0 means identical AFTER normalisation, not byte-identical.
